TRUE_RESIDENCE_TIME_ATTENUATION.geometry: Andreadis central width/depth and model reach length only; reference discharge forbidden
TRUE_RESIDENCE_TIME_ATTENUATION.complexity: one fitted nonnegative global k_day, equal to H1's one fitted global v_f
TRUE_RESIDENCE_TIME_ATTENUATION.comparison: equal-complexity non-nested challenge; a convex H1-to-residence bridge is synthetic-only

H1_CONCENTRATION_LIMITED_KN_GRID.equation: f_C=C_in/(C_in+K_N), survival=exp(-v_f*H1*f_C); for K_N=0 define f_C=1 exactly
H1_CONCENTRATION_LIMITED_KN_GRID.concentration: joint incoming quick+GW TN divided by Q72 outlet water before attenuation; readout eta is not used inside routing
H1_CONCENTRATION_LIMITED_KN_GRID.accounting: the same f_C is applied while preserving separate quick and GW mass outputs

frozen: F00, source structures and fixed T1
eta bounds, station ridge=12, log1p TN and solvers
forbidden: reach, station or tree reaction parameters
candidate_selection: P1 training TN only within each fold; P2 cannot select K_N or aquatic structure; ties select K_N=0

synthetic_gate.failure_action: close the failed candidate before observed fitting; other preflight-passing registered candidates may proceed without changing their equations or thresholds

formal_gate.primary: P1 station-macro station-demeaned log1p anomaly RMSE
formal_gate.simultaneous_test: studentized Westfall-Young/max-T over both F3 candidates with identical paired station/tree bootstrap indices
formal_gate.required: at least 10/12 point and simultaneous P1 anomaly improvements; at least 10/12 P1 station and tree absolute noninferiority; at least 10/12 P2 station and tree absolute noninferiority; no repeated eta, reaction, optimizer or K_N boundary confounding
